## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: onset, tones, side choice for the fan

Raw MR first (top), then background-subtracted vs 1/B, then windowed FFTs (low-B vs high-B split) with the FS-count model lines. Channel arithmetic R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6). Run 6 is analysed from 0.8 T up: its 50 mT sub-1 T grid Nyquist-samples a 7.3 T tone only above ≈ 0.8 T.

**Read — electron, run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹² nominal):** onset **≤ 0.8 T**. The 7.2–7.3 T tone is still `censored` at every Nyquist-valid record edge down to 0.80 T, so onset_b is an upper bound. The heavier tones' onsets are 1.4–1.8 T on the 10 mT record. Their apparent 0.8 T censoring comes from the 50 mT segment, which is above their Nyquist, so it is not trusted. Tones over the 1–10 T record (δF ≈ 1.1 T): **7.3, 14.7, 22.2, 29.5 T**. In the low-B window 7.3 T dominates. From ≈ 3 T up, a **≈ 30 T tone** dominates, with its 2×/3× comb (59/88 T) above ≈ 3.8 T: that is the F_L-like, quantum-Hall ν = 4N regime. Model at scale 1: ABAB 7.3 / 25.8 T, ABCA 33.1 T. Rxx dips slightly negative (−25 Ω) in the 6 T minimum, probably a Hall admixture on this contact pair. Frequencies are unaffected, but the channel is not a clean ρxx.

**Why this is not decisive yet:** at this density the candidate readings coincide within δF:
- (i) an ABAB pair {7.3, 22.2} plus its sum/breakdown tone 29.5 = 7.3 + 22.2. The Luttinger sum closes at a single global scale s ≈ 0.89, inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm band.
- (ii) one 7.3 T pocket plus its harmonic comb (2×, 3×, 4× = 14.6 / 21.9 / 29.2 T).
- (iii) an ABCA singleton at 29.5 T (s ≈ 0.89) plus an unrelated 7.3 T series.

Near n ≈ 3.2×10¹² the pair ratio sits on the integer 3, so the harmonic screen cannot separate (i) from (ii) at one density. The degeneracy breaks with density: the model partition falls to a light fraction ≈ 0.17 by n ≈ 2×10¹², putting the heavy tone at ≈ 0.83·F_L against 3·f_light ≈ 0.5·F_L. A harmonic tracks k·f exactly; a pocket follows its own Onsager curve and keeps the sum. **That is what the fan is for.**

**Read — hole, run 7 (n = −1.2×10¹²):** a cleaner record, onset **0.71 T**. Tones 6.6 T (dominant), 4.7, 8.5 and 12.3 T, plus harmonics. Model at scale 1: the near-CNP ABAB pair 5.9 / 6.5 T (close, balanced) and ABCA 12.4 T with m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ. This is the investigation's low-|n| hole exception regime, so it is not decisive. It is consistent with the same s ≈ 0.9 (4.7 + 6.6 = 11.3 T ≈ 0.9·F_L). Preview only; no verdict.

**Side for the fan: electron.** The D = 0 hole reach stops at −1.27×10¹² (TG −0.3 V validator), entirely inside the exception regime. The electron side reaches +3.25×10¹², where the templates separate. This follows the investigation's Step 2 design-density rule; spot-check cleanliness is secondary here.

# Runs 6-7 — SdH spot checks (sdh-spot-check), D = 0, region-A calibration (run 5). Raw first, then onset + windowed FFT.
# R = (sr1_X / 1) / I_drain, I_drain = sr0_X / -1e6. Run 6 is cut at B >= 0.8 T: its 50 mT grid below 1 T
# Nyquist-samples a 7.3 T tone only above ~0.8 T (dB <= B^2 / 2F).
import sys
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as FS

spots = {6: (+3.2, 0.8), 7: (-1.2, 0.3)}       # run: (n nominal 1e12 cm^-2, analysis B floor)
windows = {6: [(0.8, 10.0), (0.8, 3.0), (3.0, 10.0)], 7: [(0.71, 10.0), (0.71, 3.0), (3.0, 10.0)]}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (rid, (n, bfloor)) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6; R = r.col("sr1_X") / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]; k = B >= bfloor; B, R, I = B[k], R[k], I[k]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n) * 1e16)
    ab = FS.abab_mstar(n * 1e16); ca_F, ca_m = FS.abca_mstar(n * 1e16)
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n:+.1f}e12 (nominal), D = 0 | B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, {len(B)} pts | "
          f"I {np.median(I)*1e9:.2f} nA | R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm | T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K")
    print(f"    F_L = {FL:.1f} T (scale 1) | model ABAB (F, m*): " + ", ".join(f"{f:.1f} T/{m:.3f}" for f, m in ab) +
          f" | ABCA {ca_F:.1f} T/{ca_m:.3f}")
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=bfloor, r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
    print(on.summary())
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw, n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (sr1 50 uV FS = 5 kOhm)")
    m = (B >= on.onset_b); bg = np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], R[m] - bg, lw=0.6); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("dR (Ohm), deg-5 bg in B")
    ax[1, j].set_title(f"bg-subtracted from onset {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    for lo, hi in windows[rid]:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), bg_degree=5, log=False); s = sp[0]; mm = f > 2
        pk, _ = find_peaks(s[mm], prominence=0.1 * s[mm].max())
        top = sorted(zip(s[mm][pk], f[mm][pk]), reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f"    FFT [{lo:.2f}, {hi:.1f}] T (dF {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{ff:.1f} T ({a/s[mm].max():.2f})" for a, ff in top))
        ax[2, j].plot(f, s / s[mm].max(), lw=0.9, label=f"[{lo:.2f}, {hi:.0f}] T")
    for f_, _m in ab: ax[2, j].axvline(f_, color="g", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="r", ls=":", lw=1.2); ax[2, j].axvline(0.9 * FL, color="r", ls="-", lw=0.5, alpha=0.5)
    ax[2, j].set_xlim(0, 2.2 * FL); ax[2, j].set_ylim(0, 1.1); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7)
    ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].set_title("windowed FFT; green = ABAB model, red dotted = F_L (s = 1), faint = 0.9 F_L")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`), electron side, D = 0

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti e-side: n +3.25 to +2.00e12 x36 at D=0 (run-5 cal), B 0.8 to 5.0 T x78 uniform 1/B, fast\_delay 1.8 s, sr1 20 uV; ends at 5 T, gates parked · **ETA ~07:59** (≈2h30m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (ana, runs 6–7) cannot separate the readings at one density. At n = +3.2×10¹² the tones {7.3, 22.2, 29.5 T} fit two readings equally well:
- an ABAB pair plus its sum tone (7.3 + 22.2 = 29.5, closing at a global scale s ≈ 0.89);
- a 7.3 T pocket plus its 3× and 4× harmonics.

The pair ratio sits on the integer 3 there. The degeneracy breaks with density. Toward n ≈ 2×10¹² the ABAB heavy tone moves to ≈ 0.83·F_L while 3·f_light falls to ≈ 0.5·F_L. A harmonic tracks k·f; a real pocket keeps f₁ + f₂ = s·F_L(n) with a single s. The fan tests exactly this, per column (investigation Steps 4–5).

**Design** (`landau-fan` step 1: both-axis Nyquist, cost floor):
- **Side: electron.** At D = 0 the hole side stops at −1.27×10¹² because of the TG −0.3 V validator. That is inside the near-CNP exception regime, where the templates don't separate (Step 2).
- **Density window: n = +3.25 → +2.00×10¹²**, nominal run-5 calibration.
  - The top is the TG validator: V_tg = 0.998 V.
  - The bottom is where the light partner falls below ≈ 4 periods and the heavy tone drifts into the ≈ 0.9·F_L mimic regime.
- **Field window:**
  - **B_lo = 0.8 T.** `sdh_onset` still reports the 7.2 T light tone as censored at 0.80 T. That is the lowest edge where run 6's 50 mT segment is Nyquist-valid, so the onset is ≤ 0.8 T (the hole side measured 0.71 T).
  - **B_hi = 5 T.** The heavy tone's resolution is limited by its own ≈ 1.4 T onset, so raising B_hi buys little: δF 1.9 T at 5 T vs 1.6 T at 10 T.
- **B-axis sampling:** 78 rows uniform in 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.0136 T⁻¹. That puts Nyquist at 36.7 T, above F_L(3.25) = 33.6 T at scale 1 (2.2–2.4 points per period).
- **n-axis sampling:** 36 points, Δn = 0.036×10¹², which is 2.2 points per Landau-level period at B_lo.
- **Light-partner period count:** 7.8 periods at n = 3.25, ≈ 5 at n = 2.3, and 4.1 at n = 2.0 (marginal there, flagged).

**Coverage trade.** Excluded:
- **The hole side:** not reachable inside the validators. Changing a validator is session-banned.
- **5–10 T:** the quantum-Hall ν ≈ 12–16 ladder, a weak layer-number complement only. It would cost ≈ 45 min (36 min bare traverse + 7 rows) and can be taken later as a measured ride-down.

Known hazard: above ≈ 3.8 T, the F_L tone's 2× comb (≈ 60 T) aliases to ≈ 13–15 T at this Δ(1/B). Its n-slope is negative, so it is identifiable. Pocket tones are read from the B ≤ 3.8 T window; the high-B window serves only the F_L-tone-origin split.

**Settings:**
- Dwell 1.8 s = 6τ (τ 0.3 s / 24 dB, per-column-FFT rule).
- sr1 at **20 µV = 2 kΩ full scale**. Worst corner: R₀(n = 2.0) = 73 Ω (run 5), and run 6 peaked at ≈ 130 Ω up to 5 T, so headroom is > 5×. The guard prints a warning if |X| exceeds 90 % of full scale.
- Leak trip at 1 nA interrupts the run.
- Gates park at the end; the field is **held at 5 T** for the next step (the LK mass sweeps start from there).

**Price:** 78 rows × (36 × 1.95 s + 7 s turnaround) ≈ 100 min, plus the 0.8 → 5 T traverse (31 min bare) and positioning from 0 T (6 min). Total ≈ 2 h 17 m nominal. The per-point figure is calibrated on run 5 (1.10 s/pt at a 1.0 s dwell) and the per-step field overhead on run 6 (+3.1 s per step).

**Checkpoints:**
1. **First 2 rows:** signal level vs full scale, leakage, dead or flat channels, T.
2. **Row ≈ 43 (B ≈ 1.5 T, ≈ 65 min):** per-column FFT over 0.8–1.5 T. The light tone should appear and move with n. Abandon if no column shows it.
3. **Row ≈ 62 (B ≈ 2.5 T, ≈ 1 h 40 m):** preliminary F(n) — light, heavy vs 3·f_light, and the F_L tone. The last 16 rows are ramp-limited (≈ 40 min).

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`) for the stacking call: electron side, D = 0 (region-A cal, run 5) ===
# Slow: magnet.field 0.8 -> 5.0 T, 78 rows UNIFORM IN 1/B (d(1/B) = 0.01364 1/T; Nyquist 36.7 T vs F_L(3.25e12) = 33.6 T at scale 1).
# Fast: paired (Vtg, Vbg) n-line at D = 0, n = +3.25 -> +2.00e12 nominal, 36 pts (dn = 0.0357e12; 2.2 pts per LL period at B_lo).
# Dwell 1.8 s = 6 tau (tau 0.3 s / 24 dB), per-column SdH FFT fan. sr1 fixed at 20 uV = 2 kOhm FS.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration (run 5, cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N, D0 = 3.25, 2.00, 36, 0.0          # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.8, 5.0, 78                     # T
ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / B_LO, 1.0 / B_HI, N_B)          # uniform in 1/B, ascending in B
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
_nr, _Dr = calc_nD(Vtgs[[0, -1]], Vbgs[[0, -1]], CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"fast n-line: n {ns[0]:+.3f} -> {ns[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({N_N} pts), D = {D0}; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; roundtrip n {_nr}, D {_Dr}")
print(f"slow B: {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1]:.5f} 1/T, "
      f"dB {(B_vec[1]-B_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mT (first) .. {(B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2])*1e3:.0f} mT (last)")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vaporizer = {_Tv:.3f} K, heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), "
      f"B = {_B0:+.4f} T (read; cell ramps it to {B_LO} T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), sr1 tau {_tau} s / {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24), drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency():.3f} Hz")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "heaters not off"
assert abs(_B0) <= B_LO + 0.05, f"magnet at {_B0} T — expected at/below the fan start (never re-traverse)"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24, "lock-in tau/slope changed from the priced 0.3 s / 24 dB"
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency() - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed from 1 V / 13.777 Hz"

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 3.0          # 6 tau per point; slow_delay covers the row flyback (+ magnet 3 s settle)
I_TRIP = 1e-9                              # A, either gate -> interrupt
SENS = 20e-6                               # 2 kOhm FS at 10 nA: R0(n=2.0, D=0) = 73 Ohm (run 5), run-6 max to 5 T ~130 Ohm
sr1.sensitivity(SENS)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V ({sr1.sensitivity()/1e-8:.0f} Ohm FS at 10 nA); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti: electron side, D = 0 (run-5 cal), n {N_HI:+.2f} -> {N_LO:+.2f}e12 x {N_N}, "
                  f"B {B_LO} -> {B_HI} T x {N_B} uniform 1/B, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, sr1 20 uV; stacking FS-count fan")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO:+.2f} to {N_HI:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (nominal, run-5 cal: ratio 0.773, c_tg 2.796e-3 prior, '
              f'n_offset -0.089, D_offset -0.013), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T, {N_B} rows uniform in 1/B, {N_N} n-pts; '
              f'investigation tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4; per-column SdH FFT; sr1 20 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast_delay 1.8 s')

# --- position: gates to the fan start, then the magnet to B_LO (blocking ramp ~6 min from 0 T) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', 'T_sample')

_rail = []
def fan_guard(station, data):
